step1_analysis.description: A pseudo-differential amplifier with NMOS input devices, NMOS cascodes, and PMOS active loads. It is likely used as a residue amplifier in the algorithmic ADC mentioned in the paper.

paper_reference.title: Digital Background Calibration of an Algorithmic Analog-to-Digital Converter Using a Simplified Queue

dc_gain.description: Differential DC gain of the amplifier

sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain is limited by the non-cascoded PMOS loads in this specific extracted netlist.
Based on estimated gm and the paper's reported 170fF load capacitance.

sky130_expected.calculation: Single dominant pole at output, non-dominant poles at cascode nodes.
sky130_expected.reasoning: With 170fF load, the output pole is dominant, ensuring good phase margin.
Scaled down for a single amplifier stage in 1.8V SKY130.
Rising slew rate is limited by the fixed PMOS bias current.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench for pseudo-differential cascode amplifier measuring DC gain, GBW, phase margin, power, and slew rate.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Pseudo-differential cascode amplifier testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N3 N5 N1 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N1 LABEL_NET_1 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N2 LABEL_NET_2 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N3 N4 LABEL_NET_4 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N0 N4 LABEL_NET_5 VDD sky130_fd_pr__pfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N0 N5 N2 GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}

* Power and Biases
VVDD VDD 0 1.8
V_L4 LABEL_NET_4 0 1.8
V_L5 LABEL_NET_5 0 1.8
V_N5 N5 0 1.0

* CMFB for PMOS bias (N4) to set output common-mode to 0.9V
B_cmfb N4 0 V={1.0 + 100*(v(N0)+v(N3)-1.8)}

* Inputs (DC=0.6V, AC diff=1V, Pulse for slew rate)
V_INP LABEL_NET_1 0 DC 0.6 AC 0.5 PULSE(0.6 1.1 1n 100p 100p 10n 20n)
V_INN LABEL_NET_2 0 DC 0.6 AC -0.5 PULSE(0.6 0.1 1n 100p 100p 10n 20n)

* Load capacitance (170fF from paper)
C1 N3 0 170f
C2 N0 0 170f

* Differential output VCVS for easy measurement
E_diff out_diff 0 N0 N3 1.0

.control
  * DC Operating Point & Power
  op
  let power = - (i(VVDD) + i(V_L4) + i(V_L5)) * 1.8
  print power
  print v(N0) v(N3) v(N4) v(N5) v(N1) v(N2)

  * AC Analysis for Gain, GBW, Phase Margin
  ac dec 100 1 10G
  let gain_db = vdb(out_diff)
  let phase = 180/PI * cph(v(out_diff))
  
  meas ac dc_gain find gain_db at=10
  meas ac gbw when gain_db=0 fall=1
  meas ac phase_at_gbw find phase when gain_db=0 fall=1
  
  * Transient Analysis for Slew Rate
  tran 10p 20n
  meas tran sr_rise deriv v(out_diff) when v(out_diff)=0.5 rise=1
  meas tran sr_fall deriv v(out_diff) when v(out_diff)=0.5 fall=1
  
  quit
.endc
.end
